exposure: labor induction in women with one previous cesarean section
previous vaginal delivery after cesarean section
cohort: 353 women with a history of one previous cesarean section
finding: Labor induction in women with a previous cesarean section was associated with a 47.9% vaginal delivery rate and a 3.8% uterine rupture rate.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal delivery was 47.9% among women with a previous cesarean section who underwent labor induction.
